title: COUNTIF vs COUNTIFS
description: Compare COUNTIF and COUNTIFS to count cells based on one or multiple conditions.
intro: COUNTIF counts cells that meet a single condition. COUNTIFS counts cells that meet multiple conditions. If you ever plan to add more criteria, start with COUNTIFS.
whenToUseA: Use COUNTIF when you have a simple, single condition and no plans to add more criteria.
whenToUseB: Use COUNTIFS when you have two or more conditions, or when you want a formula that can easily grow.
verdict: COUNTIFS is the better choice for any new counting work, especially if multiple criteria are possible.

faq.question: What is the maximum criteria for COUNTIFS?
faq.answer: Excel supports up to 127 range/criteria pairs.
